reviewer: Original Home easy_overnight, independent AI technical source review; no new tests/native installation
decision: approved Debian adapter scope with explicit qualification limits
reviewed_boundaries: Graphical pkexec authorization binds PKEXEC_UID to a real non-root desktop account; fixed system-owned package executable/helper and protocol marker are checked before using the adapter. No arbitrary user plan grants privilege.

Privileged helper copies only trusted installed helper into root-owned private outside-runtime transaction staging; both exact release archives require publishedSHA256, no reused leaf or linked archive; archives remain retained.

Frontend dpkg lock uses nonblocking fcntl lock, trusted regular identity and DPKG_FRONTEND_LOCKED child environment. Package version/metadata/architecture/configured state are exact before mutation and after replacement/rollback.

Transaction writes installing before dpkg mutation; committed journal failure triggers rollback. Rollback refuses an unrelated installed version; failed or unverified rollback retains both archives and reports recovery required. Initial journal failure cannot mutate packages.
Atomic journal writes fsync payload and parent directory. Later recovery/restored journal failures do not hide the original transaction outcome.

Runtime version verification explicitly drops uid,gid,supplementary groups, uses isolated temporary HOME/XDG with blankCUDA/offscreen and sanitized environment, and checks root-owned executable before invoking it. Existing user preferences/data are retained.
Relaunch occurs only after a committed requested-version receipt from the privileged helper; unsupported families do not gain destructive installer fallback.
limits: Source review only. Existing native/private-dpkg fixture results belong to owner; no native desktop, privileged live install or release acceptance performed here.
Desktop verification proves packaged executable --version, not successful interactive GUI rendering or scientific inference.
Root-owned trust and path-based checks assume trusted administrative state; no blanket concurrent-root adversary guarantee.
Package archives/journal are retained evidence, not a general crash-automatic recovery engine; abrupt process/power interruption may still require documented recovery.
